real: Kirov-class missile cruiser / Iowa-class with missiles (unit_refs), twin Mk 71-class 203 mm, two CIWS
shape: unit_refs: the first Leviathan, now the fleet missile cruiser; the data: 64 x 11 m drawn at 0.72 (no modelSize; the old file 64.35 x 11.12 x 20.72 m); team bands on both sides; no real insignia.

target_size.source: the old file (balance.json has length 64, width 11, scale 0.72, no modelSize)

features.feature: the long flared hull (Armor) with the clipper bow, sheer, the dark bottom and boot-top, seams, portholes, hawse pipes
the decks with seam lines, non-skid walkways, yellow safety lines
the forward twin 203 mm turret: barbette, armoured gun house, sighting hoods, rangefinder, blast bags, two barrels (Part_gun > Mount_gun)
the aft twin 203 mm turret (Part_gun.001 > Mount_gun.001)
two VLS fields fore and aft of the forward turret
the four-tier superstructure: the bridge window band, bridge wings, side windows, doors, portholes, ladders
the main pyramid mast, yards, the spinning air-search radar (Part_radar > Radar), APS faces (Mount_APS), directors, whips
the twin-uptake funnel and the aft lattice mast
two CIWS on sponsons (Part_mg > Mount_mg starboard forward, Part_mg.001 > Mount_mg.001 port aft)
two RHIBs in davits (the boats), the boat crane
the hangar door and the flight deck with its markings, nets and lights
railings, life rafts, bollards, capstans, anchor chains, fire boxes, hose reels, lockers, fittings, navigation lights, Team bands

budget.note: over the maximum is information only

team_zones: decks, superstructure, mast, funnel, gun houses (Team)
wreck: the runtime sinks ships whole (ShipSinking); turrets and CIWS on their Part_* nodes
faction_style: Leviathan's fleet: grey naval steel, Team on the hull band and superstructure
